title: A perfect insight
text: Pilar was a superb host - friendly, approachable, knowledgeable and just perfect for the group. We tried a full range of dishes and learnt about how people from Seville choose to eat and enjoy food and drink. 100% do this!
author: Bobster2018

title: Must see!
text: Pilar is awesome! We had so much fun.

title: Great trip!
text: Great time going to learn about food, wine and history of Sevilla with Anto, highly recommend great way to start a trip
author: 364deek

title: Great Sevilla food tour
text: Alejandro was awesome and very knowledgeable about Sevilla culture and food. He is very open to questions and was able to answer all questions I had. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Sevilla that wants to know more about the lifestyle and eat foods like a local!
author: gianmarcelp

title: A great evening in...
text: A great evening in Seville hosted by the lovely Elena. We got to taste some great wines (and the local Cruzcampo beer) and the tapas from all 4 of the locations visited were excellent. Elena’s local and historical knowledge was fantastic. Highly recommended
author: Alan_P

title: Top food and drink tour
text: We had a great food tour with Elena, she gave us lots of information about Sevilla and places to visit in the city. Well worth the money with the amount of food and drinks included. Lasted just over 3hrs, which was just about right. Highly recommended.
author: wendyian

title: Great evening of company and tapas
text: Fantastic evening.  Elena was a great guide so friendy and informative.
author: richardm04

title: A must do!!!
text: Elena was an absolute delight. We had a very fun and insightful tour. The food and wine choices were great and I highly recommend!!
